label: D1 after a1 -> S2 rare-rewarded, agent about to stay with a1 (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1, never at GO or D2. About 90% of activation mass falls on D1 steps where the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (prev_action==1, prev_common==0). The strongest activations (top two quartiles, about 91% covered) come when that rare trial was rewarded and the agent then repeats a1. That is a non-model-based stay; the false positives of the broader predicate are mostly trials where the agent switches to a2. The only FUTURE variable is action at D1, the agent's own upcoming choice, which it computes; the version without it (prev_action/prev_common/prev_reward/ep_trial) gets dev F1 0.48 vs 0.60. Activity is strongly episode-time dependent: it is essentially absent before trial 40 and peaks at trials 60-89, which is also when value is in the 5.2-7.1 band. Weak, low-magnitude activations (bottom quartile) occur after a1 rare-unrewarded trials, and occasionally at D1 after other a1 trials. It never fires after a2 choices or after common transitions. The broad condition (D1 after a1 rare) has recall 0.88 but precision 0.10, so the late-episode gating is not fully captured.
